# Every backend test file that reads the wall clock, with the count frozen when
# it was admitted. Held by gates/wallclockfixtures_test.go.
#
# A READ, not a call: `NewStore(db, time.Now)` hands the clock over as a value,
# which is the idiom that matters most — the store stamps rows at wall time and
# no fixture helper can move it.
#
# The list only falls. A file may shrink; at zero its entry comes OUT, which is
# what holds it at zero for good. A file not listed may not start reading the
# wall clock — it takes its instant from clocktest.Now(t), which is what lets
# the drift lane move it.
#
# THIS FILE IS THE ONLY PLACE THE POPULATION IS COUNTED. It moves whenever this
# branch rebases, so prose that repeated the number went stale every time; the
# documents point here instead.
